t: The Hamster Wheel and the Safe Harbor: A Developer's Escape from Tech Churn
s: This article critiques the rapid obsolescence and complexity of modern web development, advocating for a return to foundational, stable technologies like text manipulation, the *nix philosophy, and Python as a path to developer sanity and lasting skill.
sub: Critique of web development churn (ASP.NET, JavaScript frameworks, build processes)
Advocacy for stable, fundamental technologies (*nix philosophy, text manipulation, Python)
Lessons from Amiga computing on craftsmanship and muscle memory
The 'All Tech is Text' realization as a unifying principle
Pipulate project as an embodiment of this alternative philosophy
